title: Forward replay of a buffer suffix
statement: Let $x,w,out$ be Boolean words, let $p$ be an input-head position for $x$, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j\le |w|$. Starting with the replay machine in its emitting state, its work-tape head at position $j$, and output $out$, after $|w|-j+1$ steps it halts with the work-tape head at position $|w|$ and output $out$ followed by the suffix of $w$ beginning at position $j$; the input-head position remains $p$.
replaced: For every input word, input position, buffer $w$, position $j \le |w|$, and output prefix, running the replay machine in its emitting control for $|w| - j + 1$ steps appends exactly the suffix of $w$ from position $j$ to the output and halts on the right blank, without any spurious trailing bit.
